host_supplied_boundaries: ObjectStroke, drawable, RTV1, manager, and render-thread object memory layouts are allocated and initialized by the host; only the SmPath constructor is called natively.
ObjectStroke methods return the fixture point, pressure, signed timestamp, optional tilt, and optional orientation arrays.
PenGLDataManager::GetMsgQueue returns a synthetic queue; its virtual submit operation reports success without running a render-thread task.
PenReturnCallback construction, buffer access/installation, pen-rectangle publication, and destruction are host stubs.
The actual native InkPenStrokeDrawableRTV1::AddPoint method appends to a host allocated std::vector<float>; its post-redraw contents are read directly.
The __cxa_guard_acquire/release imports use host stubs; the harness does not execute full Android library/global initialization.
MotionEvent accessors return the final stored coordinates and axes; GetEventTime models Base semantics as signed final timestamp minus signed first/down timestamp, per Base 0xc0634–0xc0648.

Terminal MotionEvent getters use host values. A separate native method-entry trace observes MotionEvent::GetOrientation zero times across all 21 curve-enabled and curve-disabled cases; optional saved orientation does not establish terminal orientation use.

Pen storage is host allocated and zeroed without running Pen::Pen. Native Pen::SetSize, SetScreenResolution, and getSettingData execute; InkPen::SetCurveEnabled, SetFixedWidthEnabled, and SetFixedWidth execute on a host Pen layout whose +120 field points to host-created InkPenData. The fixture declares all values explicitly.

The harness directly calls V4 RedrawPen with host-created ObjectStroke state and native-set InkPenData bytes. It bypasses Drawing redrawIPen and does not supply StrokeType; the separate source trace documents caller admission.
limits: Fresh ordinary saved redraw only; clean cached-point reuse and StrokeData cache publication are excluded.
Curve-enabled or curve-disabled branch, explicit InkPen V4 saved profile, tool type 1, 2, or 3, fixed width disabled, one stroke, finite complete point/pressure/timestamp arrays.
Native SmPath and the InkPen V4 redraw, movement, width, end, drawPoint, and rectangle code execute; render queue dispatch, GPU shader, pixels, PDF, and final appearance do not.

The test-only Rust numeric core matches the 17 curve-enabled callback fixtures; it is not routed into production rendering. Curve-disabled native outputs are recorded but not yet compared to a Rust no-curve implementation.

Host-built object layouts and C++ static guard stubs can omit startup invariants outside the exercised saved-redraw calls; these outputs establish the selected synthetic call path, not full application lifecycle parity.

Curve-enabled sample_ends record point 0 after its initial dot, then each saved point after reDrawLine returns; terminal_start/end delimit the separate endPen suffix. Curve-disabled sample_ends record point 0 before the line loop and later samples after drawLine_NoCurve returns; terminal_start/end delimit endPen_NoCurve. Terminal output remains unassigned to saved samples.

Resolution evidence covers explicit (0,0) baseline, 1080x1920, 1440x2560, 2160x3840, and 1920x1080 configured through native Pen::SetScreenResolution. It does not infer document/device resolution selection or default screen configuration.
Curve-disabled records exercise reDrawPen_NoCurve plus the V1 line and movement helpers and include exact per-sample and terminal vector boundaries.

execution_profile.path_measurement: Actual libSPenBase.so SmPath constructor and calls execute in the native redraw.
execution_profile.callback: Actual RTV1 AddPoint method executes through virtual slot +64 bytes and writes its float triples to the installed native vector pointer.
execution_profile.fresh_instance: A new Unicorn instance, library map, and zeroed host heap are created for each case; native plugin constructors and full global initialization are not run.
execution_profile.terminal_clock: The MotionEvent constructor and GetEventTime accessor are host stubs; the host computes signed last_timestamp - first_timestamp exactly for the documented bounded i32 channel domain.
execution_profile.sample_mapping: Curve path: loop 0x31050, reDrawLine call/return 0x31090/0x31094, terminal endPen call/return 0x31164/0x31168. No-curve path: loop 0x31604 reads x27 remaining count; drawLine_NoCurve call/return at 0x31648/0x3164c; endPen_NoCurve call/return at 0x316fc/0x31700. Hooks observe vector lengths on that one native execution; terminal suffix is separate.
execution_profile.screen_resolution: Each case declares [width,height]. The harness calls actual Pen::SetSize(float) at libSPenPenCommon.so +0x45fdc, then SetScreenResolution(int,int) at +0x460b4 and getSettingData() at +0x464a0. SetSize applies native [0.4,800] bounds and stores at Pen+24; getSettingData returns that same address. Pen memory is host allocated and zeroed; Pen::Pen constructor/full Pen startup is not run. Resolution setter stores dimensions at Pen+56/+60 (setting_data+32/+36).
execution_profile.curve_enabled: Each case explicitly sets host-created InkPenData through native InkPen::SetCurveEnabled(bool) at +0x24a3c, which writes byte +8. True enters the curve path; false branches to reDrawPen_NoCurve. Drawing obtains the saved bit from ObjectStroke::IsCurveEnabled() at Drawing 0x81f0c, masks bit 0 at 0x81f18, and passes it to the drawable virtual at 0x81f20; the oracle bypasses that caller and supplies the state through the native setter.
execution_profile.stroke_type: Drawing ObjectDrawing::redrawIPen(ObjectList) at 0x82abc checks count; for one stroke it reads GetStrokeType at 0x82b10, routes type 1 through secondary vtable slot 24, and all other values through slot 40 at 0x82b54-0x82b70. Slot 40 reaches V4 ObjectStroke RedrawPen through thunk 0x317c0. The list-count-not-one branch uses slot 48. InkPen settings version 4 selection and the curve boolean are separate configuration decisions; this fixture directly invokes V4 and does not execute or witness a StrokeType case.
execution_profile.saved_settings: Drawing configures Pen advanced settings and stroke parameters in drawObjectStroke 0x81bb0-0x81bf8. InkPen factory parsing of saved setting 4; selects GL V4 separately from StrokeType; that route is described in docs/reverse-engineering/inkpen-v4-findings.md. The no-curve cases retain setting 4; only InkPenData byte +8 changes.
execution_profile.fixed_width: The main 21 cases leave fixed width disabled. The harness calls native InkPen::SetFixedWidthEnabled(bool) at +0x24a74 and SetFixedWidth(float) at +0x24aac for each case and checks resulting data bytes +9/+12. Drawing separately obtains IsFixedWidthEnabled at 0x81f3c and GetFixedWidth at 0x81f6c, passing them to drawable setters at 0x81f50/+0x81f7c. Dedicated enabled cases are in the sidecar fixed-width fixture.
